title: Dominic and the Silence
author: Tamsin Hartwell
blurb: Petra Vane, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the demolition date arrives.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
